description: Edge 캐시 TTL
products: [cache-rules]
---

import { Example } from "~/components";

`example.com`을 포함하는 모든 호스트명에 대해 Cloudflare 엣지에서 리소스를 하루 동안 캐시하도록 Edge 캐시 TTL을 조정하는 [캐시 규칙 만들기](/cache/how-to/cache-rules/create-dashboard/):

<Example>

- **When incoming requests match**: Custom filter expression
  - Using the Expression Builder:<br/>
    `Hostname contains "example.com"`
  - Using the Expression Editor:<br/>
    `(http.host contains "example.com")`

- **Then**:
  - **Cache eligibility**: Eligible for cache
  - **Setting**: Edge TTL
    - Ignore cache-control header and use this TTL
      - **Input time-to-live (TTL)**: _1 day_

</Example>
